questions.title: Which Gulf country will announce an indefinite trade embargo against Iran by August 20, 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official government announcements, as reported by Al Jazeera or other reliable international news organizations.
  • Qualifying Event: The country's government must publicly announce an indefinite trade embargo against Iran between August 1 and August 20, 2026. Restrictions limited to individual companies or particular commodities do not qualify.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve on the date the embargo is publicly announced, rather than its implementation date.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The full name of the country.
questions.accepted_format: The full name of the country.

questions.title: Which armed group will the United States explicitly identify as an Iranian proxy in an August 2026 designation update?
questions.background: The United States uses counterterrorism designations and financial sanctions to target armed organizations and their funding networks.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: An official U.S. Treasury or State Department announcement issued during August 2026, corroborated by contemporaneous reliable reporting.
  • Qualifying Event: The announcement must explicitly update an armed group's existing U.S. designation to identify that group as an Iranian proxy. A statement alleging Iranian support without announcing a designation update does not qualify.
  • Resolution Date: The date the qualifying designation update is publicly announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The commonly used name of the armed group whose designation is updated.
questions.accepted_format: The commonly used name of the armed group whose designation is updated.

questions.title: Who will be announced as the second-ranked candidate on Raam’s slate for Israel’s next parliamentary election by September 5, 2026?
questions.background: Raam is an Arab political party in Israel led by Mansour Abbas. The party participated in Israel’s governing coalition formed in 2021.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: A public announcement by Mansour Abbas or Raam, as documented in official statements or contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the person publicly named by September 5, 2026, to occupy the second position on Raam’s electoral slate for the next Knesset election. An announcement of the planned candidacy is sufficient; formal registration or election to parliament is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The person’s full name.

questions.title: Which Israeli cabinet minister, if any, will unveil a named plan to remove Gaza's entire Palestinian population during the first week of September 2026?
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public statements by Israeli cabinet ministers, documented in contemporaneous reporting by established news organizations.
  • Qualifying Event: Between September 1 and September 7, 2026, inclusive, a serving Israeli cabinet minister must publicly introduce an explicitly named plan for removing Gaza's Palestinian population from the territory. General endorsements of population removal or proposals for evacuating particular areas within Gaza do not qualify. Implementation is not required.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the minister's full name, or “None” if no qualifying announcement occurs.
questions.accepted_format: Provide the minister's full name, or “None” if no qualifying announcement occurs.

questions.title: Which bank will the U.S. Treasury sanction over alleged financial ties to Iran during August 31–September 6, 2026?
questions.background: The United States uses financial sanctions to restrict institutions accused of helping Iran access the international financial system.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official U.S. Treasury sanctions announcements and Office of Foreign Assets Control designation records.
  • Resolution Conditions: Identify the bank newly sanctioned during August 31–September 6, 2026, for allegedly facilitating financial transactions for Iran. Resolve when the Treasury publicly announces the designation.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The bank's commonly used name.

questions.title: Who will control Yemen's Mayun Island on September 11, 2026?
questions.background: Mayun, also known as Perim, is an island in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait at the southern entrance to the Red Sea. Its location makes it strategically important for maritime traffic.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Contemporaneous reporting by The Associated Press or Al Jazeera identifying which military actor exercises territorial control over Mayun Island.
  • Resolution Date: Resolve according to confirmed control on September 11, 2026. Territorial control means physical possession of the island, not merely a sovereignty claim or the ability to threaten nearby shipping.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The commonly used name of the armed group, government, or coalition controlling the island.
questions.accepted_format: The commonly used name of the armed group, government, or coalition controlling the island.

questions.title: Which country will privately ask Iran to help rein in Yemen's Houthis following an appeal from Saudi Arabia by September 17, 2026?
questions.background: The Houthis are an Iran-aligned armed movement in Yemen.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Reuters reporting between August 1 and September 17, 2026, identifying the country that privately asked Iranian officials to help restrain the Houthis after receiving a Saudi appeal over Houthi attacks.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-17
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the country's common English name.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the country's common English name.

questions.title: Which sector will show the largest year-on-year percentage decline in Iran's official GDP report for March 21–June 20, 2026?
questions.background: Iran is at war with the United States and Israel.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Statistical Center of Iran's GDP figures for March 21–June 20, 2026, publicly reported by September 21, 2026. The answer is the economic sector with the greatest year-on-year percentage contraction among the sectors reported.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-21
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the sector's conventional name.
questions.accepted_format: Answer with the sector's conventional name.

questions.title: Which activist detained in Tunisia's Global Sumud Flotilla fundraising case will suspend his hunger strike between September 12 and September 27, 2026?
questions.background: Four activists have been detained since March in a Tunisian investigation into alleged financial irregularities involving fundraising for the Global Sumud Flotilla, an international campaign seeking to deliver aid to Gaza. Hunger strikes are being used to protest their continued detention.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera identifying which of the four detained activists has suspended his hunger strike.
  • Resolution Conditions: The suspension must have occurred between September 12 and September 27, 2026, inclusive. Appeals to suspend the strike or statements of future intention do not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The activist's full name.

questions.title: Which country's representative office in Ramallah will have its diplomats stripped of their Israeli-issued diplomatic status in September 2026?
questions.background: Foreign governments maintain representative offices to conduct diplomatic relations with the Palestinian Authority.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Public announcements by Israel's Foreign Ministry, corroborated by reliable contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the country whose diplomats at its representative office in Ramallah are formally announced to have had their Israeli-issued diplomatic status revoked during September 2026. The announcement of revocation is sufficient; implementation need not be independently verified.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country's name.
